title: Disk Persistence
description: Unlike memcached, MirDB persists data to disk using SSTables. Your data survives server restarts and system failures.

title: LSM Tree Architecture
description: Built on a Log-Structured Merge-tree design with memtables, immutable memtables, and multi-level SSTable compaction for efficient writes.

title: Memcached Protocol
description: Full compatibility with the standard memcached text protocol. Use your existing memcached clients without any code changes.

title: Snappy Compression
description: Data blocks are compressed using Snappy for reduced storage footprint while maintaining fast read and write performance.

title: Bloom Filters
description: SSTable-level bloom filters reduce unnecessary disk reads by quickly determining if a key exists in a given file.

title: Tokio Async Runtime
description: Powered by Tokio for high-performance asynchronous I/O, enabling efficient handling of many concurrent connections.
